name: feedback
description: Governed feedback module for Wren (improvement doc A5). Records Ross's feedback about a Wren message/answer into an append-only registry (data/registries/qsb_wren_feedback.jsonl) as REVIEWABLE evidence only. Two actions: 'record' appends one feedback row; 'digest' shows recent feedback grouped by category. HARD GUARDRAIL: this NEVER retrains, rewrites, or edits Wren's mind/persona/memory. It only accumulates evidence a human reviews later. Categories: correct, incorrect, helpful, misunderstood, too_slow, identity_error, memory_error, relay_corruption.

action.description: 'record' appends a feedback row; 'digest' groups recent feedback by category.

category.description: Required for action=record. The feedback category.

target.description: For action=record: which Wren message/answer this feedback is about (id, quote, or short reference).

note.description: For action=record: free-text detail from Ross about what was right/wrong.

n.description: For action=digest: how many recent rows to summarise.

authored_by: Claude for Wren (A5 governed feedback module)

governance.effect: append-only reviewable evidence; human review required for any improvement
